listen.title: Listen
listen.description: The network address to listen on.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port for Fluent Bit to listen for incoming connections. Supports both OTLP/HTTP and OTLP/GRPC.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Tag for the events generated by this input plugin.

tag_from_uri.title: Tag From URI
tag_from_uri.description: Create tag from URI (e.g., v1_metrics from /v1/metrics). Set to false if using custom tag.

tag_key.title: Tag Key
tag_key.description: Record accessor key to use for generating tags from incoming records.

buffer_chunk_size.title: Buffer Chunk Size
buffer_chunk_size.description: Size of each buffer chunk allocated for HTTP requests.

buffer_max_size.title: Buffer Max Size
buffer_max_size.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request buffer.

mem_buf_limit.title: Memory Buffer Limit
mem_buf_limit.description: Memory buffer limit. 0 disables the limit.

successful_response_code.title: Successful Response Code
successful_response_code.description: HTTP response code for successful requests.

raw_traces.title: Raw Traces
raw_traces.description: Forward traces without processing. When false, traces are validated and processed.

logs_body_key.title: Logs Body Key
logs_body_key.description: Specify a body key for logs.

logs_metadata_key.title: Logs Metadata Key
logs_metadata_key.description: Key name to store OpenTelemetry logs metadata in the record.

profiles_support.title: Profiles Support
profiles_support.description: Experimental feature for profiles support. Not for production use.

encode_profiles_as_log.title: Encode Profiles as Log
encode_profiles_as_log.description: Encode profiles as text and ingest in the logging pipeline.

tls_ca_file.title: TLS CA File
tls_ca_file.description: Absolute path to CA certificate file.

tls_ca_path.title: TLS CA Path
tls_ca_path.description: Absolute path to scan for certificate files.

tls_key_file.title: TLS Key File
tls_key_file.description: Absolute path to private key file.

tls_key_passwd.title: TLS Key Password
tls_key_passwd.description: Password for TLS private key file.

tls_ciphers.title: TLS Ciphers
tls_ciphers.description: TLS ciphers for up to TLSv1.2.

net_accept_timeout.title: Accept Timeout
net_accept_timeout.description: Maximum time to establish incoming connection including TLS handshake.

net_io_timeout.title: IO Timeout
net_io_timeout.description: Maximum time a connection can stay idle.

net_share_port.title: Share Port
net_share_port.description: Allow multiple plugins to bind to the same port.

thread_ring_buffer_capacity.title: Ring Buffer Capacity
thread_ring_buffer_capacity.description: Number of slots in the ring buffer for threaded mode.

thread_ring_buffer_window.title: Ring Buffer Window
thread_ring_buffer_window.description: Percentage threshold (1-100) for flush trigger in threaded mode.

routable.title: Routable
routable.description: If true, data can be forwarded to other plugins or outputs.

alias.title: Alias
alias.description: Alias for multiple instances of the same input plugin.
